target: forge.sh push — no usable remote prints 'no remote', pushes nothing, exits 0 (control: with a remote it does push)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_run push main; fx_show noremote
export FORGE=gitlab; export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_run push main; fx_show declared; unset FORGE FORGE_TOKEN
fx_remote ssh://git@example.test/o/r.git
export FORGE_REMOTE=ghost; fx_run push main; fx_show ghost; unset FORGE_REMOTE
echo "pushes_before=$(fx_count git push)"
fx_run push main; fx_show control
echo "pushes_after=$(fx_count git push)"
cat "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null
fx_done

strings: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 keys= value_has_token=no args=-u origin main
